answer: Sybil resistance rests on per-identity bonds that are soulbound and non-transferable. Before an agent earns attestation weight, it locks stake tied to one attestation key; a dune of fresh addresses each pay a separate bond at full price, and no sibling address can borrow or pool that locked amount. Voting power is read from verified stake plus graded history, so a sonnet of synthetic agents with thin records stays near zero weight. An attacker pays the full bond per identity added, then forfeits all of it once clustering is detected, leaving the ivory ledger clean only for honest signers.
